apps.name: Breakout
apps.description: Classic brick-breaking action with escalating levels and touch, keyboard, encoder, or D-pad controls.
apps.changelog: v1.0: Initial release with adaptive rendering, levels, lives, scoring, and multi-input controls.

screenshots.alt: Breakout ready screen with rainbow brick rows, paddle, score, level, and lives
screenshots.caption: Classic rainbow-brick gameplay

apps.name: Calculator
apps.description: iOS-style calculator with touch, joystick, and encoder support.
apps.changelog: v1.1.1: Fixed touch, swipe, hardware, and keyboard Back navigation and added an app preview.

screenshots.alt: Calculator showing its numeric display, five-row keypad, orange operators, and touch Back button
screenshots.caption: Touch-friendly calculator keypad

apps.name: Device Inspector
apps.description: Comprehensive hardware and API test suite with responsive native UI. Tests WiFi, BLE, GPS, RGB, storage, canvas drawing, input events, and theme inspection.

apps.name: Doom Port
apps.description: DoomGeneric with a responsive RGB565 renderer, joystick controls, and bundled Freedoom game data.
apps.changelog: v0.1.7: Moves large working buffers (screen buffer, spare frame, WAD cache) to the strict PSRAM allocator with runtime checks, requires firmware with the PSRAM allocator API, doubles WAD cache blocks to cut internal-heap DMA thrash, and improves C5 throughput with the fast C5 frame path, width-aware framebuffer stride, faster SD SPI clock, and 70 MHz ParlIO.

apps.name: ESP32 Finder
apps.description: Continuous WiFi OUI scanner with canvas dashboard and RGB blink.

apps.name: GB Emulator
apps.description: Game Boy and Game Boy Color emulator (gnuboy) with responsive scaling, save states and per-device controls.
apps.changelog:
v0.1.0: Initial DMG/CGB emulation via vendored gnuboy, ROM picker, save states and battery saves.
v0.2.0: Absolute-deadline frame pacing (fixes ~26% fast emulation), PPU render skipping on non-displayed frames, async canvas blit, fixed-point canvas scaler, and native-style pause menu and About page.

screenshots.alt: Pokemon Crystal running in the GB Emulator on a 240x320 panel, with the on-screen D-pad, A and B buttons, Start and Select, and a pause button
screenshots.caption: Pokemon Crystal on the Game Boy Color emulator

apps.name: HackChat
apps.description: Send short nearby messages directly to other GhostESP devices over ESP-NOW.
apps.changelog: v1.0.6: Fixed initial UI rendering, keyboard return, and message delivery; refresh now updates in place with simpler peer cards.

apps.name: Light Cycles
apps.description: A fast top-down light-cycle trail game against a CPU rider with swipe, keyboard, encoder, and D-pad controls.
apps.changelog: v1.0: Initial release with dirty-region rendering, CPU opponent, round results, and multi-input controls.

screenshots.alt: Light Cycles round result showing cyan and pink trails with a You Lose message
screenshots.caption: Neon trail gameplay and round results

apps.name: Pong
apps.description: Full-screen Pong with a responsive CPU opponent and touch, keyboard, encoder, or D-pad controls.
apps.changelog: v1.2: Added dirty-region rendering for substantially smoother gameplay.

screenshots.alt: Pong gameplay with score, center line, player and CPU paddles, and a touch Back button
screenshots.caption: Full-screen gameplay

apps.name: QR Generator
apps.description: Create scannable QR codes from text and URLs with touch, keyboard, encoder, or D-pad input.

screenshots.alt: QR Generator menu with actions to edit text, show a QR code, reset the URL, or go Back
screenshots.caption: QR Generator actions

apps.name: RD-03D Radar
apps.description: Connect to one or more RD-03D ESP-NOW radar nodes and view a 70-degree 2D radar display with 10m range.
apps.changelog: v0.1.17: Continuously scans in Connect, removes stale devices there, and preserves selected streams while viewing Radar.

apps.name: Snake
apps.description: Classic Snake with adaptive portrait and landscape layouts and responsive swipe controls.
apps.changelog: v1.0: Initial release with adaptive layouts, increasing speed, scoring, and multi-input controls.

screenshots.alt: Snake gameplay with green snake, red food, score, and touch Back control
screenshots.caption: Adaptive grid-based Snake gameplay

apps.name: Tetris
apps.description: Adaptive falling-block puzzle game with hold, ghost piece, seven-bag randomizer, levels, and scoring.
apps.changelog:
v1.0: Initial release with adaptive layouts, hold, ghost piece, next queue, scoring, and multi-input controls.
v1.1: Responsiveness fixes - polled held-button DAS movement and on-demand rendering.

screenshots.alt: Tetris gameplay with falling pieces, ghost piece, score, level, lines, hold, and next queue
screenshots.caption: Adaptive Tetris gameplay
